Type-1 Narrative and Plans
Zoning Map Amendment
located at 1857 W 16th Street
From M2-2 to C3-2

1a, Project Description: Within the existing 50,000 square feet space we will operate a limited
manufacturing production and industrial use specifically manufacturing of food and beverages,
operate a tasting room, full-service kitchen and bar, secondary use operate small to medium venue
space with a maximum occupancy of not more than 200 persons within the existing 1 story
industrial building with 6 on-site parking spaces; | the applicant is requesting a type-1 as per
section 17-13-0303-D Optional Administrative Adjustment and variation specifically an
Administrative Adjustment as per section 17-13-1003-EE and 17-10-01012-B Transit Served
Location (18* St. Pink Line CTA stop) which is within 1013 feet distance fram the property to the
entrance and or exit of the CTAtrain station line. The site will provide 20 on-site bicycle parking
spaces. The existing grand-fathered building is over 50 years old with prior use as a factory. It is
surrounded by mixed use, including B2-3 on the South end, and industrial manufacturing on the
North and West ends, and RT-4 on the East end.

1b. Project’s floor area ratio:

Existing FAR: 0.71
Lot area: 75,145.05 sq. ft.
Building size: 52,945. sq. ft.

1c. Project’s density (lot area per dwelling): Not applicable. There are no current plans for any
dwellings.

1d. Amount of off-street parking: 6 spaces. Applicant is requesting relief to reduce the required
parking by 100%

1e. Existing Setbacks:

Front: Zero

Rear: Zero

Side West: Zero

Side East: 167.11 feet

1f. Existing Building Height: 1 story, 36 feet, 3 inches
